question: Does the per-call counted work of the PKM Kummer relation finder depend on the algebraic presentation of the same instance at m = 3, 4, and how does each presentation's work grow with the base size B = 2^t?

claims.C1: identical verified decompositions across arms (semantics-adjusted), classifier agreement, planted found
claims.C2: per cell and label stratum, median paired log2(w_A/w_chain-tower) differs from 0, same sign on every curve, on w, w^+ and w^solve, msolve proxy co-gate
claims.C3: per-arm secant gamma_A(t->t+1) on nested bases, reported with spread, no gate

arms.membership: remainder tower R_j = X^(2^j) mod Q

not_run: monolithic at m >= 4 (S_5 degree 8; S_6 not expandable)

instruments.classifier: pkm_m8_panel targets (exhaustive signed multisets; real_count, real_count_distinct, algebraic_count)
instruments.host: this container, 4 vCPU, 15 GB, one call at a time

curves.rule: 16 | p-1, not Fermat, prime-order curve, B_real(t=4) >= 5, least such prime >= 2^18 (c1), >= 2^20 (c2), >= 2^22 (c3, m = 3 only); nested bases g*mu_4 ⊂ g*mu_8 ⊂ g*mu_16 on one curve

order: cells in table order; curves c1,c2,(c3); instances in draw order; arms in table order then A/A; native then msolve; resumable runner; lost row rerun once tagged rerun
stop_rules: chain-tower censored on > half of a cell's instances on a curve: remaining cells of that m not run

work_definition.censored: w_lo from progress file; +inf on the candidate side, -inf on the baseline side; both censored dropped and counted

primary_metrics: median paired log2(w_A/w_chain) per cell per label stratum

decision_rule.statistic: median of paired log2 ratios, per cell, per label stratum, pooled over the cell's curves
decision_rule.test: exact paired sign-flip, p <= 0.05/k (k = candidate arms in the cell)
decision_rule.interval: percentile bootstrap of the median, 20000 resamples, level 1-0.05/k
decision_rule.supported_within_scope: p <= 0.05/k AND interval excludes 0 AND same sign of per-curve medians on every curve AND |median| > D_AA AND same sign on w_plus and w_solve AND msolve proxy median same sign
decision_rule.invalid_measurement: C1 fails on a completed instance
decision_rule.inconclusive: otherwise; fewer than 8 valid pairs; positive control not detected in the cell; co-gate disagrees
decision_rule.family_wise: not controlled across cells and strata; number of tests reported

controls.blinding: hidden.json never read; analysis after plan end

budget.route: local container (isolab budget exhausted; owner declined a paid host)
budget.worst_case: caps bound each call at 600 s

non_improvement_sentence: no presentation effect at m <= 4 is a measured improvement of the index-calculus baseline; no leaderboard row changes; no claim about m = 8
section_5a: all arms priced in one native unit; no cross-method ranking; no rho comparison

adopted: S13 (partly: literal A/A and positive control; random-base null, Magma, enumeration reference listed as not run)
